Are you passionate about transport and logistics? Bleckmann is looking for you! 

We are looking for logistics employees for the Bleckmann warehouses in Rieme and Desteldonk (near Ghent) to support the Black Friday sale from 16 November until 4 December. You will be working in the morning shift (05u48 - 13u48).

This is a temporary assignment during a busy and dynamic peak period. It's a great opportunity to gain experience in logistics. As Bleckmann operates multiple peak periods throughout the year, you will have the opportunity to return for future assignments.

Tasks: 

• Preparing incoming orders

• You prepare the orders in order of arrival using a scanning system

• You prepare the correct documents when packing orders

We organize bus transport from Ghent to ensure easy access to Bleckmann:  

• Back and forth ride from the station of Gent-Sint-Pieters for the Rieme warehouse

• Back and forth ride from the station of Gent-Dampoort for the Desteldonk warehouse

• Departure at 5u10 

 

• Positive attitude

• Good numerical skills

• Flexibility

• Punctuality

• Fluent in either Dutch, English or French

Do you hold a valid CE driving licence and code 95? Are you already living in Belgium and looking for a stable job? And do you want to work at a reliable transport company where you can drive modern trucks and be home almost every evening?

For a leading frozen food transport and logistics company in Oostkamp, we're recruiting a CE truck driver for delivering frozen food products to customers throughout Belgium and its neighbouring countries. Dutch isn't required for this job, so you're free to apply if you only speak English!

Your job

As a CE truck driver, lorry driver, or HGV driver, you will ensure the safe and on-time delivery of frozen food products to supermarkets, distribution centres, and business customers.

Your drives:

• Transport of frozen goods
• National deliveries throughout Belgium, but also to the Netherlands, Luxembourg, France and Germany 
• Average of 12h/day on the road (waiting and resting times included)
• Between 5 to 15 stops/day
• Never on weekends or on holidays
Routes are prepared in advance and your trailer is already loaded, connected, fuelled, and ready to go before departure.

You'll almost never have to sleep in your truck, except for some for very exceptional cases when there's no other possibility.

We're looking for a driver who:

• Has a valid CE driving licence and code 95
• Is residing in Belgium and has legal right to work in the country
• Has a good level of English
• Isn't afraid to start early in the morning and to tackle longer routes
• Has their own transport to the company (no public transport nearby   truck cannot be taken home)
Experience as a CE truck driver is a big advantage but not required. You can also apply if you've just gotten your CE driving licence!

Do you like to roll up your sleeves? 

And are you looking for a flexible job that fits your lifestyle?

Then SD Worx Jobs is the right place for you

SD Worx Jobs is looking for a logistics associate for a client located in Kruisem. 

Your tasks will be as follows:

• Helping to prepare orders with a scanning system

• Packing goods

• Labelling and marking 

• Performing quality checks

• You speak and understand English.

• Preferably, you have experience as an order picker.

We're looking for a Logistics Coordinator. 

In this role you will be responsible for handling laboratory supplies, study materials, medical devices and drug products, used in clinical trials.

Tasks:

• Manage returned materials and maintain inventory records from clinical sites
• Coordinate logistics activities for clinical studies
• Support purchasing activities when required
• Ensure compliance with company procedures and regulatory requirements
• Support the daily operations of the Central Laboratory supply team

A strong knowledge (written and spoken) in English is required, knowledge in another language is a big asset. Logistics tasks such as shipping, calling, mailing, checking in on stock, are interesting to you. A detail and client oriented mentality is needed. You ensure a day to day fluency in logistics and supply chain.

Are you looking for a new challenge as a warehouse picker? For a dynamic and growing company, we are looking for a motivated picker who enjoys hands-on work in a warehouse environment.

Your role as a Warehouse Picker

As a warehouse picker, you are responsible for:

• Order picking using a scanner

• Packing and labelling goods

• Performing quality checks on incoming and outgoing products

• Ensuring orders are prepared accurately and on time

• Keeping the warehouse clean and well-organised

• Able to work independently

• Good physical condition

• Accurately and are punctual

• You have a good knowledge of English or Dutch to correctly understand instructions

• Experience as a warehouse picker or order picker is a plus, but not required

Wat ga je doen?                
Are you passionate about travel and customer service? Get ready for a unique experience!We are looking for dynamic personalities to join our team of train hostesses and stewards at the famous Gare du Midi. This is an exceptional opportunity to represent a renowned international railway company and welcome our customers in comfort and style.Your role will involve providing a warm welcome, serving delicious meals, and attending to the needs of our passengers with grace and professionalism.Training scheduled for January 2027: A comprehensive and immersive training session awaits you to best prepare you for this professional adventure.If you're ready to embark on an enriching and exciting journey, don't miss out on this opportunity! Apply now and join us for an unforgettable work experience. Call us at 02 218 42 44 for more information (Joyce).
                Wie ben jij?                                                                                        
• You have experience in the tourism or hospitality industry.                                                                                                
• You are customer service-oriented.                                                                                                
• You are friendly, approachable, and have an excellent appearance.                                                                                                
• You are flexible and punctual (min. 25 hours/week), whether it's during the week or on weekends, early in the morning or late in the evening.                                                                                                
• Available to work 3 weekends per month.                                                                                                
Opleiding: p.a
                                                    
Vakkennis: You have strong skills in the hospitality and/or tourism industry.
                                                    
Talenkennis: You are fluent in French or Dutch and English (C1 level).
                                                    
Attesten: p.a
                                Wat bieden wij jou?                                                                                        
• A temporary position (interim) with the potential for a permanent contract.                                                                                                
• Paid training to qualify for a position in First Class on an iconic train.                                                                                                
• Salary of 17.33 with additional benefits such as bonuses and meal vouchers.                                                                                                
• Flexible working hours.                                                                                                
• Grow in a multicultural and dynamic environment.                                                            
.

Are you looking for a challenging job within one of the largest food groups in Belgium (pork meat)? Have you always been interested in pork processing and want the opportunity to learn how to debone a pig?                        

 Follow our intensive training program and quickly develop the necessary skills. As a reward for your eagerness to learn, you will receive a permanent contract.                                                   
Wij bieden
Our offer:

• Permanent contract after 25 days of training!
• Competitive salary 
• A whole bunch of benefits! Think of daily fresh meals in our company restaurant, 25% discount on personal meat orders, fun family activities, Christmas gifts, ... In short, too many to mention! 
• Job security and growth opportunities! Wij vragen
We are looking for ambitious and eager-to-learn individuals who can start early (start at 4.55 AM) and are flexible in their schedules depending on the season. 

You should be comfortable working in a cold environment and have an affinity for the food industry (pork meat), along with the associated quality and hygiene standards. 

You must be physically capable of standing and working all day and place importance on workplace safety. 

Language is not a barrier; everyone has equal opportunities, whether you speak English, French, or Dutch.

As an employer, they place great importance on innovation, service, and quality, while centering family values in the company, which are essential to its operations.

You will take ownership within the team and work together with software engineers, UX designers, product managers, and DevOps profiles to build scalable solutions.In addition to hands-on development in .NET, you will actively contribute to discussions around architecture, technical choices, quality, and further product development. Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is a subsidiary of Safran Aircraft Engines, based at Brussels Airport (Zaventem & Steenokkerzeel, Belgium), specialized in the inspection, maintenance and repair (MRO) of the advanced LEAP jet engines that power the latest generation of the Airbus A320NEO & Boeing B737MAX narrow body families. The company is a key player in the integrated CFM international MRO network. With more than 75 years of experience, and up to 20 international Part 145 certifications (EASA/ FAA/ CAAC/ …), Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is recognized as a worldwide center of expertise in the air transport industry. More than a 100 airlines, lessors, private aircraft operators and MRO partners have entrusted their engines to our company. We employ over 600 highly skilled, passionate and enthusiastic employees.As part of our growth (RAMP UP) of LEAP engines, we are looking for a CNC Operator to strengthen our teams.

As experienced CNC machine operator, you will oversee our computer numeric controlled (CNC) machines. You will be responsible for ensuring machining of subassembly, quality parts and tools specific to engineering drawings dimensions.

Your Role:

• Set up and operate CNC machines to perform various tasks, including drilling, grinding, and milling.
• Ensure CNC machines operate in compliance with company guidelines and safety standards.
• Monitor machines during operation and make necessary adjustments to optimize results.
• Inspect machinery daily to ensure proper functionality.
• Record all machine activities by completing production and quality logs.
• Provide accurate timelines and updates to clients.
• Communicate with the Methods Department regarding any issues encountered during machining.
• Ensure that machining results meet the defined work scope and quality expectations.
• Conduct regular assessments and maintenance of CNC machines.

Your Profile:

• High school diploma or equivalent qualification required.
• Minimum of 3 years of experience as a CNC machine operator.
• Ability to read and interpret mechanical documents and engineering drawings.
• Strong mechanical aptitude.
• Excellent attention to detail and a goal-oriented attitude.
• Strong comprehension and analytical skills.
• Knowledge of the latest equipment and techniques in the industry.
• Good computer skills.
• You have a very knowledge of technical English and a basic understanding of Dutch or French, with the desire to improve it.
• Willingness to work in a 3-shift system
Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Belgium, holding either an EU passport or a valid work & residence permit. Please note that we do not provide assistance with visa or permit applications.

To strengthen our Supply Chain Team we are looking for a Configuration & Logistics Officer who ensures that for a given engine, the pieces are made available for assembly within the configuration and timeframe agreed with the customer.Your role:

• You will analyse and provide the logistical needs to complete the engine.
• You read and understand the logistical aspects of the Bill of Work for the engine.
• You detect critical points in the completion process and look for an appropriate solution to achieve the objectives (e.g. Standard Exchanges, switches between different engines).
• You direct your internal suppliers (warehouse, backshop, subcontracting, purchasing).
• You complete the modules and ensure that they are prepared according to the predetermined production planning.
• You support the assembly line with missing and/or defective parts.
• You analyse the interchangeability (technical and qualitative) of pieces, in accordance with the established configuration.

Your profile:

• You have a Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain or a technical direction, or equivalent through experience.
• You have an interest in aircraft engines and want to learn more about them.
• You are communicative and dare to ask questions.
• You work in a structured, accurate and proactive way.
• You work analytically and come up with practical solutions.
• You organize, divide and control your work independently.
• You speak French or Dutch, you also have a good knowledge of technical English.
• Experience with SAP is a plus.
• You work in shifts, from Monday to Friday (6 am - 2 pm, 2 pm - 10 pm).
Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Belgium, holding either an EU passport or a valid work & residence permit. Please note that we do not provide assistance with visa or permit applications.

As part of our growth (RAMP UP) of LEAP engines, we are looking for Repair Operators/Body Shop Painters to strengthen our teams.

As a Repair Operator/Body Shop Painter, you carry out various tasks related to repairs and adjustments on aircraft engine parts

• You will review the work documents that contain the necessary elements to perform the tasks (materials, products, technical instructions, references to the reference documents, and procedures);
• You perform the assigned tasks accurately and respect the planning in order to avoid any negative impact on work organization, scheduling, or complaints from internal customers.
• You will use the required PPE when performing tasks according to the rules defined by HSE or the usual regulations within SAESB (e.g., risk analysis);
• You report clearly and precisely on identified issues, difficulties, or risks related to the activity or the product, using the designated reporting tools;
• You communicate the status of the activity/activities at the end of the shift;
• You will participate in working groups to analyze problems and improve work processes (continuous improvement, error and defect analysis and correction, internal and external audits, etc.).

Your profile:

• You hold a secondary education diploma in a technical field.
• You have a good knowledge of technical English and a basic understanding of Dutch or French, with the desire to improve it.
• You are willing to work in 2 shifts (6am - 2pm or 2pm - 10pm).

jobs.description:
Internal Sales Coördinator 

Are you an experienced people manager who enjoys bringing structure to a fast-paced operational environment? Do you combine strong leadership skills with a hands-on approach to order management, backlog management and customer service?

For an international and dynamic organization, I am looking for an Internal Sales Coördinator to lead a team of four employees.
In this role, you will be close to both the people and the operation. You will coach and develop your team, set priorities, monitor performance and ensure that customers and internal stakeholders receive clear and timely follow-up.

Your responsibilities 

 
• Lead, organize, motivate and coach a team of 4 employees on a daily basis. 
 
• Oversee order and backlog management and ensure customer service enquiries are handled efficiently. 
 
• Set priorities and distribute the workload evenly across the team. 
 
• Monitor team performance, operational metrics and KPIs, and take action where needed. 
 
• Identify training and development needs and provide ongoing coaching. 
 
• Conduct regular one-to-one meetings and performance evaluations. 
 
• Listen to team members' feedback and support them in resolving challenges or conflicts. 
 
• Create sufficient space for team members to contribute to improvement projects alongside their daily responsibilities. 
 
• Work closely with internal stakeholders to resolve escalations and ensure clear communication regarding priorities, progress and expected deliverables. 
 
• Provide management with feedback on operational challenges and identify opportunities for continuous improvement. 
 
• Contribute to a positive and collaborative working environment and organize team-building activities. 

Who are we looking for?
For this position, I am looking for someone who knows how to lead and develop people while maintaining a strong overview of the operational priorities. 

 
• You have several years of experience in a leadership or coordinating position, ideally within sales operations, order management or customer service. 
 
• You have proven people management experience and enjoy coaching, motivating and developing team members. 
 
• You have experience with backlog management and are strong at setting priorities and maintaining overview. 
 
• You are an excellent coordinator and communicator who can effectively manage expectations with different stakeholders. 
 
• You are comfortable monitoring KPIs and using them to drive team performance. 
 
• You have strong organizational, analytical and problem-solving skills. 
 
• You remain calm and effective in a dynamic environment and know how to manage competing priorities. 
 
• You are comfortable working both independently and collaboratively. 
 
• You have solid computer skills, including experience with Microsoft Office, CRM systems and SAP. 
 
• You are fluent in English. Additional languages are an asset, but not a requirement. 
 
• Experience with data modelling and data management tools is considered an advantage. 
 
• You have your own transportation, as the workplace is not accessible by public transport.

We are looking for loaders - unloaders for a leading logistics company specializing in the efficient transportation of goods.This is an on-call position, where you will be deployed as needed, providing flexibility in your schedule.This means we can also be flexible for you (for example, if there are certain days you cannot work, we can keep this in mind).You'll work in a 2 shift system.One week you'll work from 5h (morning) until 13h (afternoon)The other week you'll work from 13h (afternoon) until 21h (evening)

As a production worker, you will work together with a colleague every day to manufacture safety boots 👢. You will place components such as the steel toe cap, lining and sole into the mould. The machine automatically injects the plastic, after which you remove the finished boot. In between production runs, you clean the machine to ensure it is ready for the next production cycle.

After training, you will also be able to operate other machines. You will cut away larger excess pieces and trim fine seams ✂️. You will carry out quality checks and pay close attention to detail. Every boot must meet strict quality standards. With your keen eye for detail, you make sure that only top-quality products leave the facility.

Working together with your colleagues is important. You step in where needed and support each other in achieving the production targets. You work accurately and take pride in the end result. Are you eager to learn and quality-focused? Then this could be the opportunity for you! ✅

Sound like the job for you? Apply now and discover how you can make a difference!

Who are we looking for?

• You have some initial stable experience in a production environment ⚙️
• You speak English well; Dutch is a plus.
• You have your own means of transportation (public transport is not available).
• You are attentive and have an eye for detail. 👀
• You can work at a fast pace and are physically fit. 💪
• You are not afraid of physically demanding work.

Drive business growth by prospecting new B2B clients, developing long-term relationships and promoting innovative digital solutions across the Brussels region. Manage the full sales cycle, from identifying opportunities to closing deals, while working closely with internal teams to deliver an outstanding customer experience.

Client Details

Our client is a leading provider of digital solutions that help businesses optimise their operations, improve efficiency and accelerate their growth.

To support its continued expansion in Belgium, the company is looking for a Field Sales Representative to strengthen its commercial presence in the Brussels region.

Description

As a Field Sales Representative, you will be responsible for developing new business opportunities and expanding the customer portfolio within your assigned territory.

 

Key responsibilities include:

 

• Identifying and approaching new B2B prospects across Brussels and surrounding areas
• Managing face-to-face client meetings and building long-term relationships
• Understanding customer challenges and presenting tailored digital solutions
• Managing the sales cycle from prospecting to contract signature
• Working closely with internal teams to ensure a seamless customer experience
 

A successful Field Sales Representative should have:

 

• 1 to 5 years of experience in B2B sales, field sales or account management
• A strong commercial mindset and hunter mentality
• Excellent communication and negotiation skills
• Fluency in French or Dutch, with a good command of English
• The ability to work independently and take ownership of a territory
• A valid driving licence (B)

As Customer Service Specialist, you will be responsible for managing a portfolio of professional customers and ensuring a seamless customer experience throughout the entire order and service lifecycle.

Client Details

Our client is an international organization operating in a highly technical environment. The company collaborates with customers across multiple sectors and is known for delivering customized solutions and long-term service partnerships.

To support the growth of its Belgian activities, the organization is looking for an experienced Customer Service Specialist to join its customer operations team.

Description

As Customer Service Specialist, you will be responsible for managing a portfolio of professional customers and ensuring a seamless customer experience throughout the entire order and service lifecycle.

 

Your day-to-day responsibilities include:

• Acting as the primary point of contact for customers regarding orders, deliveries, contract-related matters and service requests.
• Managing a high volume of customer interactions by phone and email on a daily basis.
• Ensuring timely follow-up on customer requests and coordinating with internal departments to provide accurate information and solutions.
• Building strong relationships with customers by delivering a professional, responsive and service-oriented experience.

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent through experience.
• Minimum 3 years of experience within Customer Service, Sales Support, Order Management or a similar customer-facing administrative role.
• Previous experience in a technical, industrial or B2B environment is a strong asset.
• Fluent in Dutch and French with a professional command of English.
• Comfortable communicating with customers by phone on a daily basis.
•  Strong interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to handle complex customer inquiries.
•  Able to balance administrative responsibilities with frequent customer interaction.

Our client is a well-established international organization operating across multiple regions, with a complex and geographically distributed business environment.As part of an ongoing technology and transformation journey, the company is investing in the modernization of its digital landscape, infrastructure services, cybersecurity capabilities, cloud technologies, and operational resilience. Technology plays a key role in supporting business performance, operational continuity, and long-term growth.The organization combines the stability of an established international business with an evolving operating model and a strong focus on continuous improvement.To support this transformation, they are looking for their future Head of Network Infrastructure.The position offers an international working environment, exposure to strategic initiatives, and the opportunity to contribute to major technology decisions while collaborating with teams across multiple countries and functions.

Jobomschrijving

As Head of Network Infrastructure, you will be responsible for defining and delivering the global infrastructure and network services strategy while ensuring operational excellence across the organization.Infrastructure & Network Strategy

• Define and execute the global infrastructure and network roadmap.
• Establish technology standards, governance frameworks, and best practices.
• Drive modernization initiatives across network, cloud, datacenter, workplace, and infrastructure services.
• Ensure alignment between technology priorities and business objectives.
Service Ownership & Operations

• Oversee the delivery and lifecycle management of global infrastructure and network services.
• Ensure high levels of availability, security, performance, and reliability across all environments.
• Monitor service quality and lead continuous improvement initiatives.
• Support business-critical operations through resilient and scalable infrastructure solutions.
Security & Risk Management

• Collaborate with cybersecurity teams to ensure infrastructure and network services meet security standards.
• Support compliance, risk mitigation, disaster recovery, and business continuity initiatives.
• Contribute to the protection of both corporate and operational environments.
Vendor & Stakeholder Management

• Manage relationships with external service providers and technology partners.
• Oversee contract performance, service quality, and budget management.
• Work closely with business leaders, enterprise architects, and regional IT teams to prioritize initiatives and investments.
Leadership

• Lead and develop a global team of infrastructure and network professionals.
• Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
• Drive capability development and succession planning within the organization.

The ideal candidate combines strong infrastructure and networking expertise with strategic leadership capabilities and experience operating in large international environments.Experience

• Proven experience managing enterprise infrastructure and network services.
• Strong background in multinational or highly distributed organizations.
• Experience leading geographically dispersed technical teams.
• Demonstrated success managing third-party providers and large-scale service delivery environments.
Technical Knowledge

• Strong understanding of enterprise infrastructure technologies.
• Solid expertise in networking, connectivity, cloud platforms, and cybersecurity principles.
• Experience with LAN, WAN, SD-WAN, wireless networks, firewalls, remote access solutions, and cloud networking.
• Knowledge of infrastructure governance, service management, and operational excellence frameworks.
• Familiarity with industrial, manufacturing, or operational technology environments is considered an advantage.
Leadership & Soft Skills

• Strategic thinker with strong business acumen.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Ability to influence senior leadership and cross-functional teams.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
• Results-oriented mindset with a focus on service quality and continuous improvement.
• Comfortable navigating complex international environments and transformation programs.
Languages skills 

• English is mandatory, as it is the primary working language within the international organization and across global stakeholders.
• French or Dutch is strongly preferred, given the Brussels-based location of the role and the interactions with local and regional teams.
